intro: Samplex items from Sir Uribe's past quizzes, recitation questions, bar questions and new drills, from NCC 1–51 through the Family Code's property relations (FC 74–148). Take quizzes by coverage (start with the Quiz 4: Property relations preset), read the full reviewer per topic with blur mode for self-testing, or drill with spaced review: codal blanks, spotting Sir's one-word changes, and the periods, ACP vs CPG, and Art. 147 vs 148 grids.
footer: Tags: Samplex = verbatim from Sir Uribe's past quizzes and exams (several copies merged), including CivRev 2025 Quiz 4 and the CivRev midterms with his answers from the class discussion. Recitation = questions Sir asked in class (CivRev 2025 and the 2018 online situationers). Bar = QuAMTO / UP BOC bar questions, verbatim or adapted to multiple choice. New = written for this bank in Uribe's format. A yellow note means the circulated key differed from the answer here or the point is debatable; read it before trusting either. Consider a statement true only when it is absolutely true.
